title: Young Woman Posing on Rock, 1960s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white mid-century snapshot depicting a young woman casually reclining atop a large landscaping rock in a yard. Behind her is a lush lawn, trimmed hedges, a young tree, and a large building with a shingled roof featuring a dormer window. The photograph exhibits deckled or scalloped edges characteristic of personal photo prints from the late 1950s and early 1960s.
